title: Typed extraction: add a general-concept page type (neural network, transformer, ...)
description: 11-08: the first Machines on Machines knowledge run retired 35 editor-concept pages (neural network, transformer, large language model, backpropagation, reinforcement learning, hallucination, AI alignment...) because typed extraction has no general-concept page type. Ryan accepted the retirements; these pages will not come back by tagging alone. Add a concept page type so general concepts mentioned in two or more documents get pages.
